summary.text: Joseph P. Silvestri is the Republican candidate for Nevada State Assembly District 3 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Selena Torres-Fossett.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a longtime Clark County School District educator and retired ocean lifeguard, and listed education reform, public safety and lowering the cost of living as his campaign's key messages.

paragraphs.text: Silvestri grew up on Long Island, New York, according to his Ballotpedia survey response, and earned a B.A. from SUNY College at New Paltz and an M.A. from SUNY at Stony Brook.
He moved to Las Vegas in 1997 and has worked for the Clark County School District as an educator for almost 30 years, and he also worked as a real estate agent in Las Vegas.
He said he spent 32 years as an ocean lifeguard at beaches on Long Island.
In the same survey, Silvestri said he would work to break up the Clark County School District into smaller districts, fund Education Savings Accounts and expand charter schools.
He also listed fully funding law enforcement and mandatory minimums for gang crimes under public safety, and deregulating healthcare markets and reforming zoning laws under cost of living.
